entities.name: Toxrill
entities.description: Massive, rapidly reproducing slug horror created by the Temple of Toxrill, revered as a divine figure in Nephalia.

entities.name: Spawn of Grolnok
entities.description: Rival Nephalian cult that allegedly summoned an avatar of its god.

entities.name: Grolnok
entities.description: God of the Spawn of Grolnok.

events.summary: The Spawn of Grolnok allegedly summon an avatar of their god.
events.quote: When the Spawn of Grolnok allegedly summoned an avatar of their god

events.summary: In response the Temple of Toxrill performs an ancient rite on a slug infused with demon blood, creating Toxrill, which consumes half the temple.
events.quote: a massive, rapidly reproducing horror that immediately consumed half of the temple itself

relations.quote: the longstanding rivalry between the Temple of Toxrill and the Spawn of Grolnok
This ritual was conducted on a slug infused with demon blood, resulting in the creation of Toxrill
